text: True or False: Energy per operation in digital CMOS accelerators has improved by roughly 40% per year over the past decade, making the electronic baseline a moving target against which any photonic advantage must be measured.
explanation: True. The chapter stresses that digital CMOS energy per operation has fallen roughly 40% per year over the past decade, so a photonic advantage quoted against a frozen electronic baseline is misleading; the incumbent keeps improving and must be compared as a moving target.
